description: Sets Development's plans and products from gemmein/payments.json's contents ({ plans, products, consent, mappings }). The file wins: a row edited in the dashboard is overwritten, and the answer lists every change first. Needs Stripe connected, which is the founder's step (connect_payments returns the link); a product's downloadable file is uploaded on the dashboard, on the product's own page (a file path can't travel through a chat) — deliveryUrl works here. mappings is the custom rules a Stripe event flips a field on a record for: [{ eventType, collection (the collection's own name), matchField, setField, setValue }], up to 20 — sending it replaces the whole set (never a diff, same as the dashboard's own save); leave it out to keep the dashboard's rules as they are. After a buyer pays, they land on "/" unless you set returnPath (the page they land on, e.g. /thanks) — and, for anything they can come back to see, libraryPath (e.g. /library). Build those pages, then pass returnPath/libraryPath here; left out, the answer reminds you they're still "/". This is what a founder may call setting prices, plans, what they sell, or a custom webhook rule.

libraryPath.description: the page that shows what they bought, e.g. /library

returnPath.description: the page a buyer lands on after paying, e.g. /thanks

name: set_payments
title: Set plans and products
